text:
Type: woven seagrass belly basket with handles
Use: holding throws, plants or magazines on the floor; living room, bedroom, entryway
Style: bohemian, coastal, Scandinavian
Materials: hand-woven seagrass, partly dyed black, braided seagrass rim and handles
Colors: black, light natural straw
Shape: rounded belly that narrows toward a wide open top, zigzag chevron weave in contrasting bands, two looped braided handles, sturdy yet light
Feel: natural, crafted, relaxed, warm
Goes with: green plants, light wood, linen, white or terracotta walls; bohemian, coastal or Japandi rooms

product.name: FLDIS
product.description: You can choose how you want to use this basket  turned up with handles or turned down to display the contents.
